source: ONS Census 2011 KS204EW (NOMIS NM_611_1) and ONS Census 2021 TS012 (NOMIS NM_2032_1), aligned to broad country-of-birth groups: UK, Ireland, EU pre-2001, EU 2001-2011 accession, Rest of World.
caveat: Census-to-Census comparison is mostly stable for districts and unitary authorities whose ONS codes were unchanged between 2011 and 2021. Where the 2011 LA code does not match a 2021 LA (Buckinghamshire, Northamptonshire, North Yorkshire, Somerset reorganisations), the area is omitted. EU group definitions differ slightly between Censuses; the 2011 'pre-2001' group is mapped to the 2021 EU14-style group at country level.
